title: Kitsune Sorceress Unleashed
description: A dynamic female character with long dark hair, fox ears, and a white and purple martial arts outfit performs a high kick while wielding a glowing purple hammer crackling with electricity. She stands on broken stone tiles surrounded by magical sigils, purple flames, and a dark fantasy scene featuring an old witch-like figure, a demonic rabbit creature, floating lanterns, and swirling patterns.
prompt: A fierce female kitsune with long flowing black hair and fox ears wearing a white and purple gi performs a powerful high kick while swinging a large glowing purple hammer surrounded by crackling electricity and magical runes. She stands on shattered stone ground with glowing purple spirals. In the background, an elderly witch in a dark robe, a menacing floating demonic rabbit with red eyes, purple flames, floating lanterns, cherry blossoms, and intricate swirling patterns fill the dark fantasy scene.
